propositions: Teams cannot use the bridge with multiple tracker projects because it is hard-wired to one project at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair, and applier CrossProjectTargetError guard
A shared ticket store must own the project set (projects.json) rather than per-repo lists to prevent each repo from diffing other projects' tickets as remote deletions against a shared snapshot
Each ticket must record its source project and bound repos; the project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit-key=sync-there) and migration writes no events
Inbound fetch must fan-out over all configured projects and merge enrichment data (parent/comment/issuelink maps) per project into a single snapshot
Outbound mutations must be dispatch-gated to the ticket's project and rejected if it targets a project outside the configured set
Single-project stores remain writable by older binaries; only genuinely multi-project stores carrying the multi-project-bridge capability stamp fail closed on older binaries
